parsed.name: PID过程控制器
parsed.description: 这是一种工业PID过程控制器，常用于实验室或设备系统中对温度等过程变量进行闭环调节。它通常接收传感器反馈并驱动加热或其他执行单元，以实现稳定控制。
parsed.description_en: This is an industrial PID process controller used in laboratory and equipment systems for closed-loop regulation of process variables such as temperature. It typically reads sensor feedback and drives heaters or other actuators to maintain stable control.
